name: Host-depleted ONT GridION mNGS workflow (Hu et al. 2026) against clinical microbiological tests (CMT)
description: Published clinical mNGS workflow comparison; transcribed, not reproduced.

comparison.population: Organisms detected in the 62 BALF specimens by the workflow or the reference
comparison.aggregation: All organism results in the specimen set

attributes.source_locator: Table 2, block 'TGS', column group 'Clinical microbiological tests (CMT)'; Supplemental Tables S6 and S7, same block and column group
limitations: Organism-level agreement in 62 residual BALF specimens from lower respiratory tract infection; not plasma cell-free DNA and not patient-level diagnosis.

The two workflows differ in platform, library preparation, host depletion, aligner and positivity threshold together (MGISEQ-200 with BWA-MEM and RP20M >= 3; host-depleted ONT GridION with minimap2 and RP10K >= 1), so the comparison is of whole workflows, not of classifiers.
Both workflows used the same curated 20,484-genome reference database and lowest-common-ancestor assignment.

Eight of the listed authors, including co-corresponding author Lifeng Li, are affiliated with Genskey Medical Technology (Beijing), a clinical mNGS provider; the article states that the authors declare no conflict of interest. The workflows are the authors' own, so the evaluations are author_reported.

name: Organism-level agreement with clinical microbiological tests (CMT), 62 BALF specimens (Hu et al. 2026)
description: Positive and negative percent agreement of each workflow's organism calls against clinical microbiological tests (CMT), for all organisms (Table 2), bacteria (Supplemental Table 6) and fungi (Supplemental Table 7).

attributes.protocol: Reference: Culture plus additional verification: organism-specific qPCR, or Xpert MTB/RIF for M. tuberculosis complex, on discordant organisms where residual BALF allowed. Each organism result is concordant positive, sequencing positive and comparator negative, sequencing negative and comparator positive, or concordant negative; PPA = TP/(TP+FN) and NPA = TN/(TN+FP). Supplemental Tables S6 and S7 label the culture column 'Sensitivity' and 'Specificity'.
attributes.version: Table 2; Supplemental Tables S6 and S7
attributes.source_locator: Methods 'Clinical performance evaluation and reference standards' paragraphs 1-3; Table 2 footnote
limitations: Organism-level agreement; a specimen contributes one comparison per organism detected by either side.

Discrepant analysis: confirmatory qPCR or GeneXpert was run on discordant sequencing-positive findings where residual BALF allowed (19 NGS-positive and 17 TGS-positive findings confirmed), so the CMT reference depends partly on the sequencing results and favours the sequencing workflows.

attributes.rationale: Two complete clinical DNA mNGS workflows are compared on the same patient specimens against a stated reference standard, which bears on the use case's question of which workflow detects clinically relevant pathogens. It is proxy evidence: the specimens are BALF rather than plasma cell-free DNA, agreement is counted per organism rather than per patient, and the two workflows differ in platform, host depletion, aligner and threshold together.
constraints: Inspect every linked evaluation's source locator and preserved limitations before citing a result.
Do not combine these results with another protocol's results; reference standards, specimens and scoring units differ between sources.
